observations.observation: A black star field frames a large radial arrangement of irregular illustrated destination panels. Twisted branches connect moss-edged square frames; purple, electric green and gold geometric light contrast with organic vines and a central pink rosette. The whole portal is one authored website artifact, not nine separate counts. A later lower-page capture revealed the rose-eye changing from closed to open, establishing an actual animated state change without measured timing. A supplemental visit to the same service’s current forum showed a cosmic fractal masthead above dark dense rows, counts, icons and a right utility index; grouped here as the same service rather than counted separately.
